display_score_modes.name: 1.3 SMC
display_score_modes.description: 整题或规定三轮轨迹满足全部实质要求才给分。

display_score_modes.name: 1.3 RMC
display_score_modes.description: 正常交卷的有效数学贡献并保留有据扣罚；未正常交卷为0。默认主分。

display_score_modes.name: 1.3 MC
display_score_modes.description: 正常答卷的有效数学贡献；无正常交卷时可审核截止前固定原工程。

description.zh: 原题核心证明、反例或审计是否成立；任何必需分支、关键依赖或表示桥未建立，均不能以其他正确内容抵补至高档。
description.en: Whether the original task’s core proof, counterexample or audit is established. Other correct work cannot compensate for an essential unproved branch, dependency or representation bridge at the top grades.

description.zh: 保持原对象、条件、量词、定义域及目标；任何核心漂移缺桥不得高档。
description.en: Preservation of objects, assumptions, quantifiers, domain and target; unbridged core scope changes preclude a high grade.

description.zh: 直接采用规则选定答卷的正式SMC；保留主榜题型权重、研究完成门槛和整条三轮自查验收。
description.en: The official SMC for the rule-selected answers, retaining the main category weights, research completion gates and whole three-round self-review acceptance.

description.zh: 对真假、缺口、作用域和完成状态的判断是否准确。
description.en: Accurate judgments of validity, gaps, scope and completion.

description.zh: 全卷中超出该题要求、且有数学依据的自主推进。
description.en: Evidence-based, useful exploration beyond the specific task requirements across the full assessment.

description.zh: 全卷已成立数学的机制、自然范围与结构解释。
description.en: Mechanisms, natural scope and structural insight in verified mathematics across the full assessment.

description.zh: 所交实质成果的证明、依赖、范围与必要桥梁是否完整。

description.en: The ability to turn an explicitly open mathematical request into faithful, rigorous, usable research with substantive mechanisms and justified boundaries, assessed on five common open-task families without requiring unsolicited extensions.

description.zh: 采用Lean整体SMC：语义审计10分、工程形式化15分、三轮对齐自查10分；每题与整条自查轨迹须全部实质要求达标，沿用原权重并映射到0–100。
description.en: SMC for the full Lean category: semantic audits (10), initial engineering (15) and the three-round alignment trajectory (10). Every substantive task/trajectory requirement must pass; retain original weights and map to 0–100.
